arxiv-1801-01656.title: A Survey of Air-to-Ground Propagation Channel Modeling for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
arxiv-1801-01656.creator: Wahab Khawaja 1 , Ismail Guvenc 1 , David W. Matolak 2 , Uwe-Carsten Fiebig 3 , Nicolas Schneckenberger 3
arxiv-1801-01656.description: Abstract In recent years, there has been a dramatic increase in the use of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), particularly for small UAVs, due to their affordable prices, ease of availability, and ease of operability. Existing and future applications of UAVs include remote surveillance and monitoring, relief operations, package delivery, and communication backhaul infrastructure.

arxiv-2206-14962.title: GLD-Net: Improving Monaural Speech Enhancement by Learning Global and Local Dependency Features with GLD Block
arxiv-2206-14962.creator: Xinmeng Xu, Yang Wang, Jie Jia, Binbin Chen, Jianjun Hao
arxiv-2206-14962.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xinmeng Xu, Yang Wang, Jie Jia, Binbin Chen, Jianjun Hao. For monaural speech enhancement, contextual information is important for accurate speech estimation. However, commonly used convolution neural networks (CNNs) are weak in capturing temporal contexts since they only build blocks that process one local neighborhood at a time. To address this problem, we learn from human auditory perception to introduce a two-stage trainable reasoning mechanism, referred as global-local dependency (GLD) block.

arxiv-2303-06297.title: Sedentariness in quantum walks
arxiv-2303-06297.creator: Hermie Monterde
arxiv-2303-06297.description: Abstract We formalize the notion of a sedentary vertex and present a relaxation of the concept of a sedentary family of graphs introduced by Godsil [ Linear Algebra Appl . 614:356-375, 2021]. We provide sufficient conditions for a given vertex in a graph to exhibit sedentariness.

arxiv-2305-18313.description: Abstract . Fires and burning are the chief causes of particulate matter (PM2.5), a key measurement of air quality in communities and cities worldwide. This work develops a live fire tracking platform to show active reported fires from over twenty cities in the U.S.

arxiv-2310-00695.creator: Nuha Altaymani, Wissem Jedidi

arxiv-2405-06407.title: Gravitating Scalarons with Inverted Higgs Potential
arxiv-2405-06407.creator: Xiao Yan Chew, Kok-Geng Lim
arxiv-2405-06407.description: Abstract Previously, a class of regular and asymptotically flat gravitating scalar solitons (scalarons) has been constructed in the Einstein–Klein–Gordon (EKG) theory [JHEP 07 (2008), 094] by adopting a phantom field with Higgs-like potential where the kinetic term has the wrong sign and the scalaron possesses the negative Arnowitt–Deser–Misner (ADM) mass as a consequence.

arxiv-2406-14379.title: Decoding Vocal Articulations from Acoustic Latent Representations
arxiv-2406-14379.creator: Mateo Cámara, Fernando Marcos, José Luis Blanco
arxiv-2406-14379.description: Abstract \correspondence Mateo Cámaramateo.camara@upm.com \lastnames Cámara, Marcos, and Blanco Vocal Articulations from Acoustic Representations Audio Engineering Society Presented at the AES \AESConferenceNumber \AESConferenceDate , \AESConferenceLocation \AESLegalTextPrefix \AESLegalText {onecolabstract} We present a novel neural encoder system for acoustic-to-articulatory inversion. We leverage the Pink Trombone voice synthesizer that reveals articulatory parameters (e.g tongue position and vocal cord configuration).

arxiv-2411-05085.title: PadChest-GR: A Bilingual Chest X-ray Dataset for Grounded Radiology Report Generation
arxiv-2411-05085.creator: Daniel Coelho de Castro, Aurelia Bustos, Shruthi Bannur, Stephanie L. Hyland, Kenza Bouzid, Maria Teodora Wetscherek, Maria Dolores Sánchez-Valverde, Lara Jaques-Pérez, Lourdes Pérez-Rodríguez, Kenji Takeda, José María Salinas, Javier Alvarez-Valle, Joaquín Galant-Herrero, Antonio Pertusa
arxiv-2411-05085.description: Abstract BACKGROUND Radiology report generation (RRG) aims to create free-text radiology reports from clinical imaging. Grounded radiology report generation (GRRG) extends RRG by including the localisation of individual findings on the image. Currently, there are no manually annotated chest X-ray (CXR) datasets to train GRRG models.

arxiv-2502-03763.title: Systolic Sparse Tensor Slices: FPGA Building Blocks for Sparse and Dense AI Acceleration
arxiv-2502-03763.creator: Endri Taka, Ning-Chi Huang, Chi-Chih Chang, Kai-Chiang Wu, Aman Arora, Diana Marculescu
arxiv-2502-03763.description: Abstract . FPGA architectures have recently been enhanced to meet the substantial computational demands of modern deep neural networks (DNNs). To this end, both FPGA vendors and academic researchers have proposed in-fabric blocks that perform efficient tensor computations. However, these blocks are primarily optimized for dense computation, while most DNNs exhibit sparsity.

pmc-10616034.creator: Ronak Kumar Chaudhari, Priyanka A. Shah, Pranav S. Shrivastav
pmc-10616034.description: The paper describes biogenic synthesis of silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) using Adhatoda vasica leaf extracts at room temperature. The prepared AgNPs were characterized by UV–visible spectroscopy, Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy, powder X-ray diffraction, Energy dispersive X-ray (EDX), High Resolution Transmission Electron Microscope, Scanning Electron Microscopy and Thermogravimetric analyser.

pmc-11483699.title: Prediction of Treatment Recommendations Via Ensemble Machine Learning Algorithms for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Patients in Personalized Medicine
pmc-11483699.creator: Hojin Moon, Lauren Tran, Andrew Lee, Taeksoo Kwon, Minho Lee
pmc-11483699.description: Objectives:The primary goal of this research is to develop treatment-related genomic predictive markers for non-small cell lung cancer by integrating various machine learning algorithms that recommends near-optimal individualized patient treatment for chemotherapy in an effort to maximize efficacy or minimize treatment-related toxicity. This research can contribute toward developing a more refined, accurate and effective therapy accounting for specific patient needs.

pmc-11727414.title: Fatal Delayed Cardiac Tamponade Following Atrial Fibrillation Ablation: A Case Report
pmc-11727414.creator: Sylusha Gadipudi, Yashitha Chirumamilla, Philip J McDonald
pmc-11727414.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Catheter ablation procedure for symptomatic atrial fibrillation is an established treatment. Cardiac tamponade is one of the several complications associated with atrial fibrillation ablation. We present the case of a 60-year-old male with a past medical history of end-stage renal disease (ESRD) on hemodialysis, hypotension on midodrine, atrial fibrillation status post-ablation a week prior, and a cerebrovascular accident who presented to the emergency department with complaints of weakness, nausea, vomiting, confusion and some syncopal episodes for the past few days.

pmc-12542021.title: “Psychometric validation of the Persian pregnancy coercion scale and its implications for reproductive autonomy in Iran”
pmc-12542021.creator: Mahin Alinejad, Zeinab Javadivala, Hamid Allahverdipour, Parvin Sarbakhsh, Ahmad Kousha
pmc-12542021.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectivePregnancy coercion is a public health issue that affects the mental, sexual, and reproductive health of women and one of the significant factors unintended pregnancies globally, remains understudied in Iran due to the lack of culturally validated assessment tools. This study aimed to psychometrically validate the Persian version of the Pregnancy Coercion Scale (PCS) to address this gap and enhance reproductive health equity in Persian-speaking populations.ResultsThe Persian PCS demonstrated strong internal consistency (α = 0.85).

pmc-12619349.title: Real-world clinical and economic outcomes associated with supplemental oxygen therapy use among patients with fibrosing interstitial lung disease in the United States
pmc-12619349.creator: Joseph Yang, Andrea Steffens, Lee Brekke, Amy Anderson, Gursimran Basra, Amy L. Olson, Phani Veeranki, Joao A. de Andrade
pmc-12619349.description: IntroductionPatients with fibrosing interstitial lung disease (ILD) experience a decline in lung function with progressive symptoms, poor response to treatment, and reduced quality of life. While supplemental oxygen therapy is commonly prescribed in clinical practice for patients with fibrosing ILD, the long-term outcomes associated with oxygen therapy remain unclear. This study aimed to address this knowledge gap.

pmc-12953184.title: Pulmonary Artery Sarcoma With Lung Metastasis
pmc-12953184.creator: Ryoju Sato, Tomoki Teramoto, Masamitsu Hamakawa, Toshihide Yokoyama, Tadashi Ishida
pmc-12953184.description: Pulmonary artery sarcoma is a rare disease that has been frequently misdiagnosed. A 77‐year‐old woman presented with palpitations and was found to have pulmonary hypertension. Contrast‐enhanced computed tomography showed a characteristic contrast defect occupying the entire lumen of the main pulmonary artery, leading to a diagnosis of pulmonary artery sarcoma.

pmc-13105159.creator: Danjing Chen, Bingqin Xie, Hua Fang, Huajing Chang, Wenxin Qiu, Jiangwang Fang, Yunli Wu, Xian-E Peng
pmc-13105159.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPrevious studies have indicated an association between high antioxidant exposure and colorectal cancer (CRC) risk in elderly populations. However, the relationship between the oxidative balance score (OBS) and CRC risk in the general population remains unclear.ObjectiveIn this study, we used the OBS, which is based on dietary and lifestyle factors, to assess the oxidative stress (OS) status of individuals and to explore the association between OBS and CRC risk in American adults.MethodsOverall, 44,482 participants from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey

pmc-13197800.title: Comparison of Soft and Hard Tissue Outcomes Between Root‐Analog Zirconia and Conventional Zirconia Implants: A Prospective Clinical Study
pmc-13197800.creator: Ammar Almarghlani, Amirah Aldosari, Abdullah Alfarran, Rayan Sharka, Hassan Abed, Badr Othman, Ali Alghamdi, Hannah Wesley
pmc-13197800.description: ObjectiveTo compare oral hygiene parameters, crestal bone stability, and early postoperative outcomes between zirconia root‐analog implants (RAIs) and conventional zirconia implants (CZIs) over 3 months.Materials and MethodsThis prospective, controlled clinical study included 30 participants assigned to either an RAI or CZI group based on anatomical suitability for fabricating a custom RAI.

pmc-13214174.title: “A place to have fellowship”: implementing group counseling in a clinical fellowship program
pmc-13214174.creator: Anoushka Sinha, Sara M. Buckelew, Marissa Raymond-Flesch
pmc-13214174.description: BackgroundThe Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME) has endorsed recommendations to promote individual counseling services to support trainees. However, there are limited data and no clear recommendations related to group counseling services, a format that may be scalable and support peer connection.

pmc-13547153.title: Causal Explanation from a Conceptual Engineering Perspective: Non-Reductionism, Precision, and Pluralism
pmc-13547153.creator: Jaehyun Lee, Lauren N Ross
pmc-13547153.description: While projects in philosophy of science often focus on similar sorts of topics, there are often massive differences in how philosophers approach them. One approach that has enjoyed significant success—and that is modeled in the work of Wimsatt and others—involves taking a conceptual engineering perspective in analyzing these topics.

pmc-13570007.title: Causal Effects of Gut Microbiota on Morning Chronotype, Insomnia and Sleep Duration: A Two-Sample Mendelian Randomization Study
pmc-13570007.creator: Yuqin He, Jiahuan Hao
pmc-13570007.description: BackgroundThe gut microbiota has been shown to be closely associated with brain function; however, whether it exerts a causal influence on sleep traits remains to be further explored. Mendelian randomization (MR) is an emerging epidemiological approach that uses whole-genome sequencing data to infer causal relationships.

pmc-13647677.title: Engaging the digital consumer: examining how live e-commerce features shape psychological contracts and loyalty
pmc-13647677.creator: Kan Lu, Hong Chen, Maria Hamayun
pmc-13647677.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study examines how live e-commerce features shape consumers’ psychological contracts and loyalty. Drawing primarily on the Stimulus–Organism–Response framework and psychological contract theory, interactivity, entertainment, availability, and authenticity are conceptualized as platform stimuli influencing transactional and relational psychological contracts. A concurrent mixed-methods design was adopted, combining survey data from 296 consumers with behavioral analytics from 500 live-streaming sessions on major Chinese live e-commerce platforms. Structural equation modeling shows that all four features positively affect both types of psychological contracts.
